viewing_check: Both tins look open-topped with no lid visible. Worn/faded Golden Fleece 5 lb tins sell about A$97-125, good ones A$250-380. Mobilgrease worn tins sell A$22-96. A bid of $30 is below any sold price for the pair, but one eBay price is mostly condition-driven. Easy to post? Tins are bulky and light, postage ~A$15-20 each.
